# The weekly report

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

One week's operations: the pilot measures, where the time goes and the pressure that week.

## What is on the screen

1. Choose the week. This week so far, the last full week, or one of the seven before it.
2. Where the time goes. The typical time for each step finished that week, from referral to arrival.
3. Supporting figures. Occupancy, out of area days, delayed days and long ED waits that week.
4. Print. A paper copy of the week's report.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
